post.caption: Shakespeare's gold casket held a skull. The play is The Merchant of Venice, written in the 1590s. In Act 2, the Prince of Morocco must choose among caskets. Shakespeare did not invent that saying. Chaucer used a version around 1380 in The House of Fame. Shakespeare wrote glisters, and modern editions print glitters.
